preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Chevrolet's battery-preconditioning quick-start guide and Charging App help text (chevrolet.com returns 403, so read only as a search excerpt) describe the car automatically preconditioning the battery when you route to a DC fast charger in Google Maps, and a manual Start under Next charge. Not read on a page for this exact model year; applied to this model line on the same Ultium software. UNVERIFIED, weakest for 2023-2024 cars.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: The Weekly Driver lists the Extended Range pack as 170 kWh "as published"; GM does not say whether this is usable or total, so it may be a gross figure (Green Cars Compare, search snippet only, lists 173 kWh usable). Scaled check: 204 kWh x 20/24 modules = 170 kWh (module counts from the GM 2026 Silverado EV guide).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: InsideEVs describes the Silverado EV pack as NMC pouch cells (24-module pack); thinkEV lists NMC for 2026; same Ultium cells in all pack sizes.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: "800v" follows the class already stored for the Silverado EV Extended Range records. GM's guide gives 670 V (a charging voltage) for the 20-module pack and 800 V for the Max Range; The Weekly Driver gives 290 V nominal for the 20-module pack. OWNER FLAG: the class is a judgement (charging voltage vs nominal voltage); kept 800v to match the existing records.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: GM 2025 WT spec guide lists the Extended Range (20 MOD) pack. 670 V up to 300 kW. Several existing Extended Range records say 350 kW (the Max pack's value); this is the GM figure for the 20-module pack. The Weekly Driver 20-module page also gives 300 kW. The existing 350 kW on some 2026 Extended Range records is the Max Range figure.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: GM 2025 WT spec guide lists the Extended Range (20 MOD) pack. 11.5 kW is the base module; 19.2 kW is an option (K20 / XKT package) or standard on the 2026 WT (NRCan lists both Charger variants of the Canadian Ext Range trims, captured per trim). Powertrain value is the base 11.5 kW. LT/RST charger hardware is not covered by the WT guide: NRCan lists both 11.5 kW and 19.2 kW chargers per trim (captured per trim); powertrain value is the 11.5 kW charger. The 2025 guide row for the charging module is partly unreadable (glyph-encoded font).

published_10_80_min.notes: Estimated: GM 2025 WT spec guide lists the Extended Range (20 MOD) pack. Low-80% time to charge 42 min and 111 miles added in 10 min; column mapping to this pack inferred from the page layout (4WT 74 mi, 5WT 111 mi, 8WT 124 mi).
